decisions.reason: The retail system interface plugin remains closely aligned with the firm's integration capabilities and full-service e-commerce positioning, so after another year of commitment management is likely to continue it unless weak demand becomes unmistakable.

The shop relaunch SEO support service has visible public backing through its own page and fits the firm's core service bundle, which makes management inclined to justify continued patience by pointing to project timing and cross-selling potential.

The SEO workshops are newer and somewhat easier to discontinue than core project services, but because they were given their own page and reinforce the firm's marketing expertise, management would probably keep them while attributing any slow uptake to a still-developing market.
